subject: How to generate the bed file for eDMR. The bed file generated with methylkit does not works with eDMR

messages.author: 21065eb57dfbc0bd
messages.subject: How to generate the bed file for eDMR. The bed file generated with methylkit does not works with eDMR
parts:
Hi,

I generated the bed file required for methylkit using the galaxy programs that were suggested in the forum. But when I try to use that bed file with eDMR (the dmr analysis program). I get the following error :-

[1] "load /home/skhan/data/soybeandata/5x/data_files/gmax_bed.bed"
Error in unique(splitn(genes.obj$id, "_", 3)) : 
  error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'unique': Error in FUN(X[[1L]], ...) : subscript out of bounds

How can I make this bed file work. If not what should I do to generate a bed file that works with eDMR.

I tried contacting the author of eDMR software but she is not responding.

Kindly suggest me what needs to be done. I really need these results desperately.


regards

parts:
Hi,
Which command are you trying to use?
I think you are trying the annotation step? I am not sure what is the gmax_bed.bed format. However, the annotation data format is different for eDMR.
Please refer to the following files for the format to get genes.obj below. 
https://edmr.googlecode.com/files/hg19_refseq_all_types.bed
Cheers,
Sheng
